_about: Records, Artifacts in the CRM (Jonathan, 2026-10-02): the documents the selling runs on, grouped by what they are used for, each category with its icon. Groups read like the journey cards' artifacts (scripts/crm_server.py _resolve_group): kind files lists paths or globs from the repo root (path#Heading shows one markdown section); kind messages reads the Prospects base's Messages table; kind ads-pages lists each Google Ads campaign's page and brief. A group with nothing in it shows its missing line. Tasks (Jonathan, 2026-10-05: "Add the rewrites as tasks and those live in the artifacts as well"): the open boxes of the tasks.md sections named in task_sections show on every group whose file they name, marked To do; task_words names a group that has no file path. Edited by hand or by the AIOS.
